import pytest

from slotplan.expand_weekly import expand_weekly


def test_plain_series():
    assert expand_weekly([0, 2], 600, 630, 3) == [(0, 600, 630), (2, 600, 630), (7, 600, 630)]
    assert expand_weekly([4, 1, 1], 540, 600, 4) == [(1, 540, 600), (4, 540, 600), (8, 540, 600), (11, 540, 600)]
    assert expand_weekly([3], 540, 600, 0) == []


def test_blackouts():
    assert expand_weekly([0, 2], 600, 630, 4, [(2880, 4320)]) == [(0, 600, 630), (7, 600, 630), (9, 600, 630)]
    assert expand_weekly([1], 540, 600, 2, [(2040, 2160)]) == [(1, 540, 600), (8, 540, 600)]


def test_invalid_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        expand_weekly([7], 540, 600, 2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        expand_weekly([], 540, 600, 2)


def test_regression_issue_590():
    assert expand_weekly([0, 2], 600, 630, 4, [(2880, 4320)]) == [(0, 600, 630), (7, 600, 630), (9, 600, 630), (14, 600, 630)]

acceptance/test_free_slots.py.initial:
import pytest

from slotplan.free_slots import free_slots


def test_gaps():
    assert free_slots([(600, 660), (780, 840)], 540, 1020) == [(540, 600), (660, 780), (840, 1020)]
    assert free_slots([(500, 560), (1000, 1100), (620, 650), (600, 630)], 540, 1020) == [(560, 600), (650, 1000)]
    assert free_slots([(600, 660), (700, 720)], 540, 1020, min_length=45) == [(540, 600), (720, 1020)]


def test_buffer():
    assert free_slots([(600, 660)], 540, 720, buffer=10) == [(540, 600), (670, 720)]
    assert free_slots([(600, 660), (690, 750)], 540, 1020, min_length=30, buffer=15) == [(540, 600), (765, 1020)]


def test_invalid_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        free_slots([], 600, 540)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        free_slots([], 540, 600, buffer=-5)


def test_regression_issue_433():
    assert free_slots([(600, 660)], 540, 720, buffer=10) == [(540, 590), (670, 720)]
